eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Duval, FL; at 2:37 PM on AUG 29, 2023 Effective until 6:37 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Express transportation is available via JTA Bus to the hurricane evacuation shelter at the Legends Center until 10 p.m. Transportation will resume tomorrow at 6 a.m., weather permitting. 

The Bus Stop is located at Moncrief Road and Ken Knight Drive East (Bus Stop 3991).

For more information, visit www.jaxready.com.
